# Deutsche Bundesbank — Germany

Verified 2026-10-11. Publisher: central-bank.

**Documented market:** Central-bank cash-account / interbank reporting examples for EBICS and SWIFT; not commercial retail accounts.

**Formats / versions:** camt.052.001.08; camt.053.001.08 (intended; published namespace defects)

## Official resources

- [Original SWIFT sample archive](https://www.bundesbank.de/resource/blob/943092/4b2c43de91b04dc4cf2b36ee73a025aa/472B63F073F071307366337C94F8C870/beispieldateien-format-camt-052-swift-data.zip) — sample-file; public-file
- [Original EBICS sample archive](https://www.bundesbank.de/resource/blob/943090/3d1c4aa7aa18e86e724a5a42ce10a889/472B63F073F071307366337C94F8C870/beispieldateien-format-camt-052-ebics-data.zip) — sample-file; public-file

## Scope and source notes

22 unchanged XML originals (20 CAMT052 and two CAMT053) are stored in this repository with attribution. Five have unused namespace declarations and are invalid against the intended schema. Other report examples can omit balances needed for conversion. These are reference fixtures, not a converter compatibility certification.

[Publisher usage terms](https://www.bundesbank.de/de/startseite/benutzerhinweise/benutzerhinweise-642874?index=2).
